user.title: Connect to Kirk Hill Wind Farm
user.description: Sign in with your Kirk Hill dashboard account and the integration gets an API key for you, or enter a key you already have.

menu_options.oauth2: Sign in with your Kirk Hill dashboard account (recommended)
menu_options.manual: I already have an API key

manual.title: Connect to Kirk Hill Wind Farm
manual.description: Enter your Kirk Hill dashboard API key. Forecast entities use Open-Meteo automatically (no forecast API key required). You can also enable optional experimental Ethex payment tracking onboarding.

oauth2.title: Sign in with the Kirk Hill dashboard
oauth2.description: You will open dashboard.kirkhillcoop.org and approve access to your wind farm data. The dashboard never shares your password, account details or ownership records with this integration.

settings.title: Set up Kirk Hill Wind Farm
settings.description: Signed in. Choose the site name and what to create. Forecast entities use Open-Meteo automatically (no forecast API key required).

reauth.title: Reauthenticate Kirk Hill Wind Farm
reauth.description: Your Kirk Hill API key is no longer valid. Enter a new API key.

error.permission_required: This key cannot read both your share and the whole wind farm. The integration needs both: choose “My share and whole wind farm” when signing in, or use a key that allows both permissions.
error.oauth_unavailable: Could not reach the Kirk Hill dashboard to sign in. Try again, or choose "I already have an API key".

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Kirk Hill Wind Farm is allowed.
abort.reauth_failed: Reauthentication failed: the config entry could not be found.
abort.oauth_key_invalid: The key returned by the Kirk Hill dashboard could not be used to reach the API. Try signing in again, or add an API key manually.
abort.oauth_permission_denied: The dashboard granted a key that cannot read all of the data this integration uses. Sign in again and choose “My share and whole wind farm”.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: Sign-in was cancelled before permission was granted.

init.title: Kirk Hill Wind Farm options
init.description: Adjust polling and finance options. Forecast entities use Open-Meteo automatically (no forecast API key required). Enable experimental payment tracking onboarding to configure Ethex.
